'''Moshe Kaveh''' ({{Langx|he|משה קוה}}; born 1943) is an Israeli [[physicist]] and former President of [[Bar-Ilan University]].<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|date=November 4, 2018|url=https://www1.biu.ac.il/indexE.php?id=33&pt=20&pid=4&level=1&cPath=4&type=1&news=3229|title=Council for Higher Education to Award Prize to Former University President Prof. Moshe Kaveh|website=Bar Ilan University}}</ref><ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ilsussidiario.net/intervistati/moshe-kaveh/|title=Moshe Kaveh - Le interviste}}</ref>

==Biography==
Kaveh was born in [[Tashkent]], [[Uzbek SSR]], [[Soviet Union]] where his parents sought safety after fleeing from [[Poland]].<ref name="auto1"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www1.biu.ac.il/indexE.php/indexE.php?id=3&pt=20&pid=4&level=1&cPath=4&type=1&news=1651|title=Bar-Ilan University Celebrates Sino-Judaic Friendship|date=June 3, 2012|work=www1.biu.ac.il}}</ref> All of his father (Rabbi David Kaveh)'s ten siblings perished in [[the Holocaust]]. The Kaveh family immigrated to Israel in 1950.<ref name="auto1"/>

He is a Professor in the Department of Physics at [[Bar-Ilan University]]. 
He has published over 300 articles on physics.<ref name="auto"/> Kaveh was Chairman of the Department, Dean of the school's Faculty of Natural Sciences, and Rector of Bar-Ilan.<ref name="auto1"/>
He completed his bachelors, masters, and doctoral degrees at Bar-Ilan University.

Kaveh was President of Bar-Ilan University from 1996 to 2013, succeeding [[Shlomo Eckstein]] and followed by [[Daniel Hershkowitz]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://physics.biu.ac.il/en/node/769|title=Kaveh Moshe &#124; Department of Physics &#124; Bar-Ilan University|website=physics.biu.ac.il}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www1.biu.ac.il/indexE.php?id=6551&pt=1&pid=988&level=5&cPath=35,983,988|title=Bar-Ilan Presidents &#124; Bar Ilan University|website=www1.biu.ac.il}}</ref> In 2013 he resigned.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://en.globes.co.il/en/article--1000822904|title=Bar Ilan University president resigns |date=February 17, 2013|work=Globes}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-3719333,00.html|title=Bar Ilan president slams religious fear of academia|date=May 21, 2009|work=Ynetnews|author=Kobi Nahshoni }}</ref> Kaveh was chairman of Israel's Committee of University Presidents.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chronicle.com/article/Head-of-Israeli-University/123679|title=Head of Israeli University Demands Ouster of Professors Who Support Boycott|first=Matthew|last=Kalman|date=July 23, 2010|work=The Chronicle of Higher Education}}</ref>

In 2008, the [[Israel Council for Higher Education]] awarded Kaveh its Prize for Higher Education.<ref name="auto"/>
